content: Aaradhya Verma called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss her expired health policy. Neha explained that the policy expired on the 10th of the month and clarified that the premium increase was due to inflation, while highlighting the new mental health support feature and offering a 5% discount. Neha then asked if Aaradhya was ready to proceed with the renewal and payment process.

action_items: Proceed with policy renewal and payment process
